visualReview.notes: Inspected54 current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-terrain/tier frames. The bent three-span deck, opposing widened viewing platforms, two mirror-clad rectangular columns, single tapered spine, cantilever ribs, outward-leaning glass rails and kinked metal posts remain coherent. Floor windows are real openings in the opaque deck, with12 framed panes near and two aggregated inserts farther away. Clear alpha-blended glass is visible above and below; skyline deliberately uses an opaque palette proxy. Four existing256px surface graphs supply paving, concrete, coated steel and polished stainless; no private images. Signed exact-QID outline and current PMTiles bridge path preserve the two hill connections and bend locations. The unmodified standard-viewer native heightfield was actually rendered for the30 Earth frames; both ends and column feet seat against that coarse field. Four focused tests prove source/tier bytes, floor openings, native-terrain attachment and actual runtime removal of the upper bridge path while retaining the lower transverse descent road. Surveyed bridge grades, precise optical glass/cladding behavior, original connection dimensions and physical-device timings remain outside scope. Portable/shared pictures were retained from this same current-model pass; native-terrain pictures were recaptured after refreshing a stale compiled terrain prerequisite. No source, fixture or material changed between those portable/shared captures and this acceptance.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and one standard Terrarium tile; no bespoke terrain acquisition.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Native terrain was not flattened to the model. The derived5m review grid oversamples coarse mixed-source DEM. Both endpoints use ground+0.3m; shallow pier feet embed into that field. Interior/lower-road visuals are outside the fixture; actual runtime path replacement was separately tested with the retained road coordinates.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers, at most five draws, no embedded/private images and separate position/normal streams. Detailed source remains separate; no phone/laptop timing claim.
